snippet.title: Alchemical Keyboard Trailer
snippet.description:
Play through an interactive music video where you must modify the world around you in order to progress the song!

check out the game here!
https://simonlhopkins.itch.io/alchemical-keyboard

Featuring music from:
The Summer We Went West - http://www.thesummerwentwest.com/index.html
Oolong - https://oolongbois.bandcamp.com/
omniboi - https://omniboi.bandcamp.com/
bladee - https://open.spotify.com/artist/2xvtxDNInKDV4AvGmjw6d1
